1.niv: The word of the Lord came to Jonah son of Amittai:
1.cmn: 耶和華的話臨到亞米太的兒子約拿，說：
1.tao: O ciring na ni Ama ta do to do anak ni Amitay a meyngaran so Yena am,

2.niv: “Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it, because its wickedness has come up before me.”
2.cmn: 「你起來往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民呼喊，因為他們的惡達到我面前。」
2.tao: Maniring jya am, “Mangay ka do Niniwey a rako a ili a pancyan mo no keyyan da do dang no meyraraten a tao. Ta ko na nimamizing o raraten da.”

3.niv: But Jonah ran away from the Lord and headed for Tarshish. He went down to Joppa, where he found a ship bound for that port. After paying the fare, he went aboard and sailed for Tarshish to flee from the Lord.
3.cmn: 約拿卻起來，逃往他施去躲避耶和華；下到約帕，遇見一隻船，要往他施去。他就給了船價，上了船，要與船上的人同往他施去躲避耶和華。
3.tao: Am mina to meyvangon si Yena komaro ji Ama ta do to. Makaranes do Yepey am macita na o asa ka avang a mangay tomayo jya. Am ori o nipanta na so nizpi a somakay do avang a kapacihza na jira komaro ji Ama ta do to.

4.niv: Then the Lord sent a great wind on the sea, and such a violent storm arose that the ship threatened to break up.
4.cmn: 然而耶和華使海中起大風，海就狂風大作，甚至船幾乎破壞。
4.tao: Meyratateng am tovoin na ni Ama ta do to o rako a pagpag. Karahan am to rana maciralay o avang da.

5.niv: All the sailors were afraid and each cried out to his own god. And they threw the cargo into the sea to lighten the ship.
5.cmn: 水手便懼怕，各人哀求自己的神。他們將船上的貨物拋在海中，為要使船輕些。約拿已下到底艙，躺臥沉睡。
5.tao: So nikanyahey da no tao no avang a amlololos a tomawag do tao do to da a kapangay da so aro a warawara do avang, ta ihepaw da do avang. Am meygonagonay rana si Yena a to ngitkeh a to ngitkeh.

6.niv: The captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep? Get up and call on your god! Maybe he will take notice of us so that we will not perish.”
6.cmn: 船主到他那裏對他說：「你這沉睡的人哪，為何這樣呢？起來，求告你的神，或者神顧念我們，使我們不致滅亡。」
6.tao: Makaranes jya o mapeynihakawan sya am maniring jya am, “Ikongo mo to ngitkeh ang. Peyvangon rana kapanci mo no tao do to mo a somidong jyamen, ta kalittan namen an.”

7.niv: Then the sailors said to each other, “Come, let us cast lots to find out who is responsible for this calamity.” They cast lots and the lot fell on Jonah.
7.cmn: 船上的人彼此說：「來吧，我們掣籤，看看這災臨到我們是因誰的緣故。」於是他們掣籤，掣出約拿來。
7.tao: Maniring sira o kararay na am, “Paciralay tamo a macipangoyongoyot a kapakateneng ta do na karatan jyaten ni Ama ta do to.” Meyratateng am to da rana mangoztod so ovid a pangonongan.

8.niv: So they asked him, “Tell us, who is responsible for making all this trouble for us? What kind of work do you do? Where do you come from? What is your country? From what people are you?”
8.cmn: 眾人對他說：「請你告訴我們，這災臨到我們是因誰的緣故？你以何事為業？你從哪裏來？你是哪一國？屬哪一族的人？」
8.tao: kapacici da sya. Maniring sira am, “Pancyan pala jyamen, sino o yamapeyvazay so sang a na yapwan no alalaw eya. Ikongo na mina vazay jimo ang. Do wanjin mo kapwan. Sino ili mo. Sino iteytetngehan mo.”

9.niv: He answered, “I am a Hebrew and I worship the Lord, the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
9.cmn: 他說：「我是希伯來人。我敬畏耶和華－那創造滄海旱地之天上的上帝。」
9.tao: Maniring jira si Moyse am, “Yaken rana am Sipolay ko a tao. Ko iraralay si Ama ta do to a nimangamamaog so karawan a kano awa.”

10.niv: This terrified them and they asked, “What have you done?” (They knew he was running away from the Lord, because he had already told them so.)
10.cmn: 他們就大大懼怕，對他說：「你做的是甚麼事呢？」他們已經知道他躲避耶和華，因為他告訴了他們。
10.tao: Mamizing da am manyahey sira. Maniring rana sira do kadwan jira am, “Ikongo vazay mo ang.” Ta katenngan da rana o kanimakowbot na ji Ama ta do to, do kanimapatwaw na rana sya jira ni Yowani.

11.niv: The sea was getting rougher and rougher. So they asked him, “What should we do to you to make the sea calm down for us?”
11.cmn: 他們問他說：「我們當向你怎樣行，使海浪平靜呢？」這話是因海浪越發翻騰。
11.tao: Maniring sira jya am, “Makongo namen jimo, kangay namen mapadnadna so paopaong na jimo.” Ikongo do tey marahet o paopaong na, am ori o nipeykabkas na rana.

12.niv: “Pick me up and throw me into the sea,” he replied, “and it will become calm. I know that it is my fault that this great storm has come upon you.”
12.cmn: 他對他們說：「你們將我抬起來，拋在海中，海就平靜了；我知道你們遭這大風是因我的緣故。」
12.tao: Maniring si Yowani jira am, “Pangapey kamo yaken a iwalit do awa. Ta ori o ji na rana meyhanahanang nya. Ta ko katenngan o na karatan ninyo no rako a pagpag.”

13.niv: Instead, the men did their best to row back to land. But they could not, for the sea grew even wilder than before.
13.cmn: 然而那些人竭力盪槳，要把船攏岸，卻是不能，因為海浪越發向他們翻騰。
13.tao: Am ori o nikakzeban da no tao no avang a mapakarala so avang da do pamsan na am ji da pakongo, ta ikarahet na sira no paopaong na.

14.niv: Then they cried out to the Lord, “Please, Lord, do not let us die for taking this manʼs life. Do not hold us accountable for killing an innocent man, for you, Lord, have done as you pleased.”
14.cmn: 他們便求告耶和華說：「耶和華啊，我們懇求你，不要因這人的性命使我們死亡，不要使流無辜血的罪歸與我們；因為你－耶和華是隨自己的意旨行事。」
14.tao: Meyratateng am mapasyasi sira ji Ama ta do to. Maniring sira am, “Mo Ama do to, ji mo yamen wakwaka an. Ji mo mancyan yamen a nimwakwak so tao eya a meyraraten an. Ta imo rana am mo na nipangononongan o nakenakem mo, mo Ama do to.”

15.niv: Then they took Jonah and threw him overboard, and the raging sea grew calm.
15.cmn: 他們遂將約拿抬起，拋在海中，海的狂浪就平息了。
15.tao: Meyratateng am ahapen da rana si Yena kapangay da sya do awa. Ori o nikakeykai na rana a meyhanahanang.

16.niv: At this the men greatly feared the Lord, and they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made vows to him.
16.cmn: 那些人便大大敬畏耶和華，向耶和華獻祭，並且許願。
16.tao: Mamizing da no aro a tao o ciring na ni Ama ta do to am ikanyahey da rana si Ama ta do to. Am ori o nipatanang da so kagling a kano baka a patanangen da ji Ama ta do to.

17.niv: Now the Lord provided a huge fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
17.cmn: 耶和華安排一條大魚吞了約拿，他在魚腹中三日三夜。
17.tao: Meyratateng am tovoin na ni Ama ta do to o asa ka rako a among a koman si Yena. So niyan na do velek no among so katlo araw a kano katlo ahep.

1.niv: From inside the fish Jonah prayed to the Lord his God.
1.cmn: 約拿在魚腹中禱告耶和華－他的上帝，
1.tao: Amyan si Yena do velek no among am meynozi ji Ama ta do to a Tao do to na,

2.niv: He said: “In my distress I called to the Lord, and he answered me. From deep in the realm of the dead I called for help, and you listened to my cry.
2.cmn: 說：   我遭遇患難求告耶和華，   你就應允我；   從陰間的深處呼求，   你就俯聽我的聲音。
2.tao: Maniring am, “No keyyan no alalaw ko am tawagan ko si Ama ta do to . Mamizing mo o inozi ko. Mamizing mo o pasyasyan ko, do keyyan ko pa do kararatan.

3.niv: You hurled me into the depths, into the very heart of the seas, and the currents swirled about me; all your waves and breakers swept over me.
3.cmn: 你將我投下深淵，   就是海的深處；   大水環繞我，   你的波浪洪濤都漫過我身。
3.tao: Mo nipangay yaken do gazawagaw no awa, kato mo na ngilikan jyaken no rako a ranom.

4.niv: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
4.cmn: 我說：我從你眼前雖被驅逐，   我仍要仰望你的聖殿。
4.tao: Maniring ko do onowned ko am, Tana da na pasyain yaken do teyngato am ko pa ji ngamoga imo a yasomidong jyaken.

5.niv: The engulfing waters threatened me, the deep surrounded me; seaweed was wrapped around my head.
5.cmn: 諸水環繞我，幾乎淹沒我；   深淵圍住我；   海草纏繞我的頭。
5.tao: So nikatey yaro no ranom a komovot jyaken. So icyakma ney atbod a omlimot jyaken. So icyakma ney tamek a nimonong do oo ko.

6.niv: To the roots of the mountains I sank down; the earth beneath barred me in forever. But you, Lord my God, brought my life up from the pit.
6.cmn: 我下到山根，   地的門將我永遠關住。   耶和華－我的上帝啊，   你卻將我的性命從坑中救出來。
6.tao: No si meypangay ko do teyrahem no tokon am jyabo kaji da rana makatayo jyaken a. Am imo rana mo Ama do to a Tao do to ko am nipeyvangon mo o pahad ko do gazawagaw ko.

7.niv: “When my life was ebbing away, I remembered you, Lord, and my prayer rose to you, to your holy temple.
7.cmn: 我心在我裏面發昏的時候，   我就想念耶和華。   我的禱告進入你的聖殿，   達到你的面前。
7.tao: No ko mazabab so onowned am ko manakem si Ama ta do to. So yako ipeynozi jimo a yarana makaranes do rako a panaralayan mo.

8.niv: “Those who cling to worthless idols turn away from Godʼs love for them.
8.cmn: 那信奉虛無之神的人，   離棄憐愛他們的主；
8.tao: Sira rana a omanoyong do abo so peypeypangayan a iraralay da am to da nazibwan o pangangarilawan na ni Ama ta do to.

9.niv: But I, with shouts of grateful praise, will sacrifice to you. What I have vowed I will make good. I will say, ‘Salvation comes from the Lord.’ ”
9.cmn: 但我必用感謝的聲音獻祭與你。   我所許的願，我必償還。   救恩出於耶和華。
9.tao: Am ori o sarayan ko nimo a patanangen ko so nakem ko jimo a patanangen jimo. O mina ciring ko jimo am pangononongan ko an. Ta si Ama ta do to o mapatazadang jyaten.”

10.niv: And the Lord commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.
10.cmn: 耶和華吩咐魚，魚就把約拿吐在旱地上。
10.tao: Meyratateng am ipanci na rana ni Ama ta do to o among a kapeyotaotao na rana ni Yena do pamsan na.

1.niv: Then the word of the Lord came to Jonah a second time:
1.cmn: 耶和華的話二次臨到約拿說：
1.tao: Ipirwa o ciring na ni Ama ta do to ji Yena. Maniring am,

2.niv: “Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message I give you.”
2.cmn: 「你起來！往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民宣告我所吩咐你的話。」
2.tao: Maniring jya am, “Mangay ka do Niniwey a rako a ili. Ipanci mo do tao do dang o ipanci ko jimo a ciring.”

3.niv: Jonah obeyed the word of the Lord and went to Nineveh. Now Nineveh was a very large city; it took three days to go through it.
3.cmn: 約拿便照耶和華的話起來，往尼尼微去。這尼尼微是極大的城，有三日的路程。
3.tao: So nionotan na ji Yena a mangay do Niniwey, do mina ciring na jya ni Ama ta do to. So icyakma ney rako a ili do Niniwey. O ili rana ori am katlo araw o pangonongan na.

4.niv: Jonah began by going a dayʼs journey into the city, proclaiming, “Forty more days and Nineveh will be overthrown.”
4.cmn: 約拿進城走了一日，宣告說：「再等四十日，尼尼微必傾覆了！」
4.tao: Somdep si Yena do ili am kasaraw rana a niomalam. Maniring rana am, “Yana makasikapat (40) so araraw o ikabalinas na no Niniwey.”

5.niv: The Ninevites believed God. A fast was proclaimed, and all of them, from the greatest to the least, put on sackcloth.
5.cmn: 尼尼微人信服上帝，便宣告禁食，從最大的到至小的都穿麻衣。
5.tao: O tao rana do Niniwey am anoyngan da rana si Ama ta do to. Am ori o nipancyan da no tao a ji mangakaday a meynozi, tana meynakem a tana ipangoyongoyod da am meyyayob sira so zaping.

6.niv: When Jonahʼs warning reached the king of Nineveh, he rose from his throne, took off his royal robes, covered himself with sackcloth and sat down in the dust.
6.cmn: 這信息傳到尼尼微王的耳中，他就下了寶座，脫下朝服，披上麻布，坐在灰中。
6.tao: Mamizing no panirsirngen do Niniwey o akman sang a vazay am mina to meyhekas a apo do lilisnan na a kapakaro na so ayob na a meyyayob so milakayob a omlisna do tana.

7.niv: This is the proclamation he issued in Nineveh:
7.cmn: 他又使人遍告尼尼微通城，說：「王和大臣有令，人不可嘗甚麼，牲畜、牛羊不可吃草，也不可喝水。
7.tao: Meyratateng am manovoy pa so tao a mangay do Niniwey. Maniring am, “O ciring na no panirsirngen a kano meynakem a tao am, ‘Ji kamo mangakaday. Ji nyo ngyopa o ranom nyo a kano vinyay nyo.’ ”

8.niv: But let people and animals be covered with sackcloth. Let everyone call urgently on God. Let them give up their evil ways and their violence.
8.cmn: 人與牲畜都當披上麻布；人要切切求告上帝。各人回頭離開所行的惡道，丟棄手中的強暴。
8.tao: Mamimin o tao a kano omalalam a meyyayob so zaping, kapeynozi da ji Ama ta do to a komaro do marahet a icicirawat da a ji mapeyvazay so icyatatao da."

9.niv: Who knows? God may yet relent and with compassion turn from his fierce anger so that we will not perish.”
9.cmn: 或者上帝轉意後悔，不發烈怒，使我們不致滅亡，也未可知。」
9.tao: Ala mamlis si Ama ta do to a ji meyoyaoya nyaten a kaji na rana meydednan jyaten so peyoyaoyyan na."

10.niv: When God saw what they did and how they turned from their evil ways, he relented and did not bring on them the destruction he had threatened.
10.cmn: 於是上帝察看他們的行為，見他們離開惡道，他就後悔，不把所說的災禍降與他們了。
10.tao: Macita na ni Ama ta do to o kapya no icicirawat da, do kanimablis da rana so marahet a icicirawat. Am ori o nikarwan na rana no alalaw a nipanci na a ipasingsingkad na sira.

1.niv: But to Jonah this seemed very wrong, and he became angry.
1.cmn: 這事約拿大大不悅，且甚發怒，
1.tao: Mamizing na ni Yowani o akman sang a ciring am marahet o onowned na. So nipeyoyaoya na.

2.niv: He prayed to the Lord, “Isnʼt this what I said, Lord, when I was still at home? That is what I tried to forestall by fleeing to Tarshish. I knew that you are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger and abounding in love, a God who relents from sending calamity.
2.cmn: 就禱告耶和華說：「耶和華啊，我在本國的時候豈不是這樣說嗎？我知道你是有恩典、有憐憫的上帝，不輕易發怒，有豐盛的慈愛，並且後悔不降所說的災，所以我急速逃往他施去。
2.tao: So nipeynozi na ji Ama ta do to. Maniring am, “Mo Ama do to, no keyyan ko pa do ili namen am akman so sang o nipanci ko asyo. Ko katenngan imo a yatey rako so pangangarilawan a yamarilaw no tao. Mo ji meyoyaoya a yatey rako so pangangarilawan. So mo ji mamyapyai no oyaoyyan ko no tao. Am ori o ko nikakeykai a yamangay a somidong jimo.

3.niv: Now, Lord, take away my life, for it is better for me to die than to live.”
3.cmn: 耶和華啊，現在求你取我的命吧！因為我死了比活着還好。」
3.tao: Am ori o pancyan mo nyaken, mo Ama ta do to, do kawakwak ko rana. Ta apyapya pa o kawakwak ko sicyaikwaya, a kano inawan ko.”

4.niv: But the Lord replied, “Is it right for you to be angry?”
4.cmn: 耶和華說：「你這樣發怒合乎理嗎？」
4.tao: Maniring si Ama ta do to am, “Manngwa, apya o kaoyyan mo nyaken?”

5.niv: Jonah had gone out and sat down at a place east of the city. There he made himself a shelter, sat in its shade and waited to see what would happen to the city.
5.cmn: 於是約拿出城，坐在城的東邊，在那裏為自己搭了一座棚，坐在棚的蔭下，要看看那城究竟如何。
5.tao: Meyratateng am karwan na o ili da ni Yowani a kalisna na do daddan no ili da kapamaring na so asa ka sarwap a kalisna na do teyngato no vilad na tomita so angayan da ili.

6.niv: Then the Lord God provided a leafy plant and made it grow up over Jonah to give shade for his head to ease his discomfort, and Jonah was very happy about the plant.
6.cmn: 耶和華上帝安排一棵蓖麻，使其發生高過約拿，影兒遮蓋他的頭，救他脫離苦楚；約拿因這棵蓖麻大大喜樂。
6.tao: Meyratateng am pamnekan na ni Ama ta do to so asa ka voovoong a amlida do oo na ni Yena. So nikapya na rana macita nya a kaji na rana meydednan no alalaw na. So nisarayan na no kayo ang ni Yena.

7.niv: But at dawn the next day God provided a worm, which chewed the plant so that it withered.
7.cmn: 次日黎明，上帝卻安排一條蟲子咬這蓖麻，以致枯槁。
7.tao: Ikadwa na araw do apnezak am tovoin na ni Ama ta do to o asa ka zozon a omonong do nipamowa da mowamowa. Am ori o nipeymetdehan na sira.

8.niv: When the sun rose, God provided a scorching east wind, and the sun blazed on Jonahʼs head so that he grew faint. He wanted to die, and said, “It would be better for me to die than to live.”
8.cmn: 日頭出來的時候，上帝安排炎熱的東風，日頭曝曬約拿的頭，使他發昏，他就為自己求死，說：「我死了比活着還好！」
8.tao: Domada o araw am ipanovoy na ni Ama ta do to o makopad a hangin do daddan no araw a tomanek do oo na ni Yena. Am ori o nipeyzavozan na a kapanci na rana no kawakwak na. Maniring am, “Apyapya rana o kawakwak ko sicyaikwaya, ta apyapya pa o kavyay ko pa.”

9.niv: But God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the plant?”
9.cmn: 上帝對約拿說：「你因這棵蓖麻發怒合乎理嗎？」他說：「我發怒以至於死，都合乎理！」
9.tao: Maniring si Ama ta do to ji Yena am, “Manngwa, yamanoyong mo kazyakan no tamek ang?” Maniring si Yena am, “Yamanoyong ko kazyak. So ikanoyong ko a mawakwak do dang.”

10.niv: But the Lord said, “You have been concerned about this plant, though you did not tend it or make it grow. It sprang up overnight and died overnight.
10.cmn: 耶和華說：「這蓖麻不是你栽種的，也不是你培養的；一夜發生，一夜乾死，你尚且愛惜；
10.tao: Maniring si Ama ta do to am, “O tamek rana ya am beken a imo nimapamowa sya. So na ikabo no oyowyat mo a mapamowa sya. Tana asa ka mahep am mahep a kawakwak na am yamo ji peyveyveknan.

11.niv: And should I not have concern for the great city of Nineveh, in which there are more than a hundred and twenty thousand people who cannot tell their right hand from their left—and also many animals?”
11.cmn: 何況這尼尼微大城，其中不能分辨左手右手的有十二萬多人，並有許多牲畜，我豈能不愛惜呢？」
11.tao: Naknakmen nyo pala o rako a ili a meyngaran so Niniwey. Tana yaro dang so yadwa so ikakarwan a ranaw so ikalima da zivo (12,000,000) a tao a yaji makateneng do wanan da kano ozi da am jyabo kaji ko asyan so omalalam a.”

1.niv: In the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land. So a man from Bethlehem in Judah, together with his wife and two sons, went to live for a while in the country of Moab.
1.cmn: 當士師秉政的時候，國中遭遇饑荒。在猶大的伯利恆，有一個人帶着妻子和兩個兒子往摩押地去寄居。
1.tao: No kapeypanirsirngen da pa no mapacicici a tao do Yotay am amyan so rako a abcil do peycyeylilyan na. Am amyan so asa ka tao a mapalolo so mavakes na kano rarwa ka anak na mangay meyvahay do Podiheng a ili do Yotay.

2.niv: The manʼs name was Elimelek, his wifeʼs name was Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Kilion. They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem, Judah. And they went to Moab and lived there.
2.cmn: 這人名叫以利米勒，他的妻名叫拿俄米；他兩個兒子，一個名叫瑪倫，一個名叫基連，都是猶大伯利恆的以法他人。他們到了摩押地，就住在那裏。
2.tao: O ngaran no tao ori am si Idimele. O ngaran no mavakes na am si Naomi. O ngaran no rarwa ka anak na am si Malon a kani Kilen. Sira rana am meyvahay sira do Ipa a ili a macinapnap do Podiheng a macinapnap do Yotay. Makaranes sira do Moab a ili am meyvahay rana sira do dang.

3.niv: Now Elimelek, Naomiʼs husband, died, and she was left with her two sons.
3.cmn: 後來拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒死了，剩下婦人和她兩個兒子。
3.tao: Mownay am mawakwak rana o kahanghangan ni Naomi a meyngaran so Idimele. So nikamimin da rana mavakes a kano rarwa ka anak na mahakay.

4.niv: They married Moabite women, one named Orpah and the other Ruth. After they had lived there about ten years,
4.cmn: 這兩個兒子娶了摩押女子為妻，一個名叫俄珥巴，一個名叫路得，在那裏住了約有十年。
4.tao: O rarwa ka anak na am mapazagpit sira so mavakes do Moab. O asa ka mahakay am meyngaran si Opeypa. O asa am meyngaran si Lote. So niyan da do dang so asa ngarnan (10) so awawan.

5.niv: both Mahlon and Kilion also died, and Naomi was left without her two sons and her husband.
5.cmn: 瑪倫和基連二人也死了，剩下拿俄米，沒有丈夫，也沒有兒子。
5.tao: Mawakwak rana sira Malon a kani Kedisay am to rana meyyonong o ikavyay no pahad da. So nikamimin da rana ni Naomi a abo so mahakay a kano anak.

6.niv: When Naomi heard in Moab that the Lord had come to the aid of his people by providing food for them, she and her daughters-in-law prepared to return home from there.
6.cmn: 她就與兩個兒婦起身，要從摩押地歸回；因為她在摩押地聽見耶和華眷顧自己的百姓，賜糧食與他們。
6.tao: Meyratateng am mamizing na si Ama ta do to a marilaw no Isedi a tao a manta nira so kanen da. Am ori o nipeysinaoli da rana no rarwa ka anak da apo do Moab.

7.niv: With her two daughters-in-law she left the place where she had been living and set out on the road that would take them back to the land of Judah.
7.cmn: 於是她和兩個兒婦起行離開所住的地方，要回猶大地去。
7.tao: Karahan am karwan da rana o keymiminili da mavakes a mangay rana do Yotay.

8.niv: Then Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go back, each of you, to your motherʼs home. May the Lord show you kindness, as you have shown kindness to your dead husbands and to me.
8.cmn: 拿俄米對兩個兒婦說：「你們各人回娘家去吧。願耶和華恩待你們，像你們恩待已死的人與我一樣！
8.tao: Maniring si Naemey do rarwa ka mavakes am, “Angay kamo rana. Inaoy no si itoro na ni Ama ta do to o pangangarilawan na jinyo, akman jinyo a yamarilaw no nimawakwak rana tao.

9.niv: May the Lord grant that each of you will find rest in the home of another husband.”
9.cmn: 願耶和華使你們各在新夫家中得平安！」於是拿俄米與她們親嘴。她們就放聲而哭，
9.tao: Inaoy no si itoro na ni Ama ta do to o ikapiya no kataotao nyo do vayo a vahay nyo.” Karahan am rapongen na sira ni Noemi o maganam a mavakes. Meyratateng am mina to sira lavi so ciring a omlavi.

10.niv: and said to her, “We will go back with you to your people.”
10.cmn: 說：「不然，我們必與你一同回你本國去。」
10.tao: Maniring sira jya am, “Jyabo kaji namen macihzan jimo a mangay do ili nyo a.”

11.niv: But Naomi said, “Return home, my daughters. Why would you come with me? Am I going to have any more sons, who could become your husbands?
11.cmn: 拿俄米說：「我女兒們哪，回去吧！為何要跟我去呢？我還能生子作你們的丈夫嗎？
11.tao: Maniring si Naemey am, “Mangay kamo na, manga keypong. Ikongo nyo to macihzai jyaken. Manngwa, apya do vahay ko o kapazagpit ko jinyo an?

12.niv: Return home, my daughters; I am too old to have another husband. Even if I thought there was still hope for me—even if I had a husband tonight and then gave birth to sons—
12.cmn: 我女兒們哪，回去吧！我年紀老邁，不能再有丈夫；即或說，我還有指望，今夜有丈夫可以生子，
12.tao: Angay rana kamo a mangay do vahay nyo an. Ta yako rarakeh rana a ji rana meyyaven do vahay. Akman sang, ta amyan pa so kakownongan na no kapacikahanghang ko do vahay sicyaraw eya a mangahanas.

13.niv: would you wait until they grew up? Would you remain unmarried for them? No, my daughters. It is more bitter for me than for you, because the Lordʼs hand has turned against me!”
13.cmn: 你們豈能等着他們長大呢？你們豈能等着他們不嫁別人呢？我女兒們哪，不要這樣。我為你們的緣故甚是愁苦，因為耶和華伸手攻擊我。」
13.tao: Manngwa, nanalahen nyo pa sira makaveyvow an? Manngwa, pananalahen nyo pa sira kato da macivahavahayan an? Beken a akman sang, manga keypong an. Ta yako tey mazikna so onowned inyo, ta yana nipeykaraherahet yaken ni Ama ta do to.”

14.niv: At this they wept aloud again. Then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth clung to her.
14.cmn: 兩個兒婦又放聲而哭，俄珥巴與婆婆親嘴而別，只是路得捨不得拿俄米。
14.tao: Meyratateng am mina to meykaoo a amlavi o rarwa ka mavakes. Si Ope a kano meyina mavakes am rapongen da sira. Am si Lote rana am ji na nimapaoyoi si Naomi.

15.niv: “Look,” said Naomi, “your sister-in-law is going back to her people and her gods. Go back with her.”
15.cmn: 拿俄米說：「看哪，你嫂子已經回她本國和她所拜的神那裏去了，你也跟着你嫂子回去吧！」
15.tao: Maniring jya si Naemey am, “Cita pala o ananak mo a yarana meysinaoli do ili da a yamraralay no malas a tao. So to mo na macihzai jira.”

16.niv: But Ruth replied, “Donʼt urge me to leave you or to turn back from you. Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God.
16.cmn: 路得說：「不要催我回去不跟隨你。你往哪裏去，我也往那裏去；你在哪裏住宿，我也在那裏住宿；你的國就是我的國，你的上帝就是我的上帝。
16.tao: Maniring si Lote jira am, “Ji mo mancyan yaken a macihza jimo. O angayan mo am mangay ko an. O peyvahayan mo am ori o peyvahayan ko an. O italamozong mo a tao am italamozong ko an. O Tao do to mo am Tao do to ko an.

17.niv: Where you die I will die, and there I will be buried. May the Lord deal with me, be it ever so severely, if even death separates you and me.”
17.cmn: 你在哪裏死，我也在那裏死，也葬在那裏。除非死能使你我相離！不然，願耶和華重重地降罰與我。」
17.tao: O angayan mo mawakwak am ori o angayan ko a mawakwak a kabobo da nyaken do dang. Si mawakwak rana am jyabo kaji na mapeysyay jyaken a. Inaoy no si peydednan na yaken ni Ama ta do to so peyoyaoyyan na.”

18.niv: When Naomi realized that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.
18.cmn: 拿俄米見路得定意要跟隨自己去，就不再勸她了。
18.tao: Macita na ni Naome si Lote a jyakza no kapacihza na jya am ji na rana mancyan.

19.niv: So the two women went on until they came to Bethlehem. When they arrived in Bethlehem, the whole town was stirred because of them, and the women exclaimed, “Can this be Naomi?”
19.cmn: 於是二人同行，來到伯利恆。她們到了伯利恆，合城的人就都驚訝。婦女們說：「這是拿俄米嗎？」
19.tao: Makarahan am mangay rana sira do Podiheng. Makaranes sira do Podiheng am isavasavak da no tao do ili da. Maniring sira o mavavakes am, “Sino na ipanci ni Naomi ang.”

20.niv: “Donʼt call me Naomi,” she told them. “Call me Mara, because the Almighty has made my life very bitter.
20.cmn: 拿俄米對她們說：「不要叫我拿俄米，要叫我瑪拉，因為全能者使我受了大苦。
20.tao: Maniring jira si Naemey am, “Ji nyo mancyan yaken a Naemey. Maniring kamo jyaken a Mala, ta na ikarahet yaken no oyowyat ni Ama ta do to.

21.niv: I went away full, but the Lord has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi? The Lord has afflicted me; the Almighty has brought misfortune upon me.”
21.cmn: 我滿滿地出去，耶和華使我空空地回來。耶和華降禍與我；全能者使我受苦。既是這樣，你們為何還叫我拿俄米呢？」
21.tao: No kangay ko rana do dang am abwata o apzapzatan ko. Am si Ama ta do to rana am yabo o apzapzatan ko a meysinaoli do jya. So na ikanoyong a yasomidong jyaken ni Ama ta do to a yamapazavozavoz jyaken so alalaw ko. Am ikongo nyo pancyan nyaken a meyngaran si Naome.”

22.niv: So Naomi returned from Moab accompanied by Ruth the Moabite, her daughter-in-law, arriving in Bethlehem as the barley harvest was beginning.
22.cmn: 拿俄米和她兒婦摩押女子路得，從摩押地回來到伯利恆，正是動手割大麥的時候。
22.tao: No kapeysinaoli da rana ni Naemey a kano mavakes na a meyngaran so Lote apo do Moyse a ili am mangay sira do Podiheng. No kanang am mangay rana o kapeyvazay da so mogis a mogi.

1.niv: Now Naomi had a relative on her husbandʼs side, a man of standing from the clan of Elimelek, whose name was Boaz.
1.cmn: 拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒的親族中，有一個人名叫波阿斯，是個大財主。
1.tao: Amyan so asa ka mahakay a meyngaran si Poatse a tey yaro so nizpi a zipos na no kahanghangan ni Naomi a meyngaran si Idimele.

2.niv: And Ruth the Moabite said to Naomi, “Let me go to the fields and pick up the leftover grain behind anyone in whose eyes I find favor.”
2.cmn: 摩押女子路得對拿俄米說：「容我往田間去，我蒙誰的恩，就在誰的身後拾取麥穗。」拿俄米說：「女兒啊，你只管去。」
2.tao: Maniring o mavakes a meyngaran so Lote ji Naomi am, “Apyahen mo yaken a mangay do nihakawan ko a mangap so abyab do ngoso no ikarilaw ko tao.” Maniring si Naomi am, “Mangay ka, manganako.”

3.niv: So she went out, entered a field and began to glean behind the harvesters. As it turned out, she was working in a field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelek.
3.cmn: 路得就去了，來到田間，在收割的人身後拾取麥穗。她恰巧到了以利米勒本族的人波阿斯那塊田裏。
3.tao: So nyangay na ni Lote a mangay do nihakawan da omlangi so mogi. Am to rana makaranes do nihakawan ni Poatse a tao do Idimele.

4.niv: Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and greeted the harvesters, “The Lord be with you!”
4.cmn: 波阿斯正從伯利恆來，對收割的人說：「願耶和華與你們同在！」他們回答說：「願耶和華賜福與你！」
4.tao: Makarahan am nimapo si Poatse do Podiheng a kangay na do lamlamsoy na. Maniring jira am, “Inaoy si macikaop jinyo si Ama ta do to.” Maniring sira am, “Inaoy si ipanlanlag na imo ni Ama ta do to.”

5.niv: Boaz asked the overseer of his harvesters, “Who does that young woman belong to?”
5.cmn: 波阿斯問監管收割的僕人說：「那是誰家的女子？」
5.tao: Maniring si Poatse do lamlamsoy na no tomalamozong no nihakawan na am, “Sino yamyan do vahay no mavakes ang.”

6.niv: The overseer replied, “She is the Moabite who came back from Moab with Naomi.
6.cmn: 監管收割的僕人回答說：「是那摩押女子，跟隨拿俄米從摩押地回來的。
6.tao: Maniring o lamlamsoy na no tomalamozong no nimvood so mowamowa na tao am, “Iya rana am asa ka mavakes do Moyse a nimacihza ji Naome a nimapo do Moyse.

7.niv: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves behind the harvesters.’ She came into the field and has remained here from morning till now, except for a short rest in the shelter.”
7.cmn: 她說：『請你容我跟着收割的人拾取打捆剩下的麥穗。』她從早晨直到如今，除了在屋子裏坐一會兒，常在這裏。」
7.tao: Maniring o mavakes ori jya am, ‘To ko macihza do lamlamsoy ko a mangay omlangi so nipeysinsinmo da tao.’ So na ikanoyong a yanisomdep do vahay sicyaikwaya. So na ikabo no vazay na.”

8.niv: So Boaz said to Ruth, “My daughter, listen to me. Donʼt go and glean in another field and donʼt go away from here. Stay here with the women who work for me.
8.cmn: 波阿斯對路得說：「女兒啊，聽我說，不要往別人田裏拾取麥穗，也不要離開這裏，要常與我使女們在一處。
8.tao: Maniring si Poatse ji Lote am, “Manganako, amizngen mo o ciring ko an. Ji ka mangay a manlangi do nihakawan da no tao. Ji ka ngaro do jya an. Ta macikaop ka do lamlamsoy ko a mavakes an.

9.niv: Watch the field where the men are harvesting, and follow along after the women. I have told the men not to lay a hand on you. And whenever you are thirsty, go and get a drink from the water jars the men have filled.”
9.cmn: 我的僕人在那塊田收割，你就跟着他們去。我已經吩咐僕人不可欺負你；你若渴了，就可以到器皿那裏喝僕人打來的水。」
9.tao: To mo macihza jira o lamlamsoy ko a yamlangi so mowamowa ko. Ko nipanci rana jimo o kaji mo liliwan sya. No mawaw ka am to ka nangay amyop so itoro da jimo no lamlamsoy ko.”

10.niv: At this, she bowed down with her face to the ground. She asked him, “Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you notice me—a foreigner?”
10.cmn: 路得就俯伏在地叩拜，對他說：「我既是外邦人，怎麼蒙你的恩，這樣顧恤我呢？」
10.tao: Karahan am meylilitod si Lote a omraralay nya. Maniring jya am, “Yaken rana am beken a tao do Yotay ko. Am ikongo o mo karilawan nyaken.”

11.niv: Boaz replied, “Iʼve been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband—how you left your father and mother and your homeland and came to live with a people you did not know before.
11.cmn: 波阿斯回答說：「自從你丈夫死後，凡你向婆婆所行的，並你離開父母和本地，到素不認識的民中，這些事人全都告訴我了。
11.tao: Maniring si Poatse am, “Yana nimawakwak o kahanghangan mo am yamyan so tao a yamanci nya jyaken so mo kapya so nakenakem do icyarwa mo a mavakes. So mo to ngaroi do inyapwan mo a kano ili nyo a yamangay a meyvahay do matarek a ili.

12.niv: May the Lord repay you for what you have done. May you be richly rewarded by the Lord, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”
12.cmn: 願耶和華照你所行的賞賜你。你來投靠耶和華－以色列上帝的翅膀下，願你滿得他的賞賜。」
12.tao: Inaoy no si itoro na jimo ni Ama ta do to o yazaw na jimo. Inaoy no si itoro na jimo ni Ama ta do to a Tao do to da no Isedi a tao so yazaw na jimo. So ikanoyong mo a makahap so yazaw na jimo ni Ama ta do to.”

13.niv: “May I continue to find favor in your eyes, my lord,” she said. “You have put me at ease by speaking kindly to your servant—though I do not have the standing of one of your servants.”
13.cmn: 路得說：「我主啊，願在你眼前蒙恩。我雖然不及你的一個使女，你還用慈愛的話安慰我的心。」
13.tao: Maniring si Lote am, “Mo Panirsirngen, inaoy si ikarilaw mo yaken an. Tana ko jyasingkaji o lamlamsoy mo am yamo ikarilaw yaken no ciriciring mo.”

14.niv: At mealtime Boaz said to her, “Come over here. Have some bread and dip it in the wine vinegar.”
14.cmn: 到了吃飯的時候，波阿斯對路得說：「你到這裏來吃餅，將餅蘸在醋裏。」路得就在收割的人旁邊坐下；他們把烘了的穗子遞給她。她吃飽了，還有餘剩的。
14.tao: Marateng o araraw no ipamaring da so kanen am ipanci na ni Poatse ji Lote, “Sijya, kakan mo so myanpaw do nihakawan mo.” Meyratateng am amlisna si Lote do katangked da no lamlamsoy na kapanta da nya so nipeyyasi da nihakawan na. So nikamimin na nikoman a nimapanpan.

15.niv: As she got up to glean, Boaz gave orders to his men, “Let her gather among the sheaves and donʼt reprimand her.
15.cmn: 她起來又拾取麥穗，波阿斯吩咐僕人說：「她就是在捆中拾取麥穗，也可以容她，不可羞辱她；
15.tao: Meyratateng am meytatanek pa mangap so mogi. Maniring si Poatse do lamlamsoy na am, “To mo macipanadngi ori a mahap so mogi. So ji nyo macimasesneki nya.

16.niv: Even pull out some stalks for her from the bundles and leave them for her to pick up, and donʼt rebuke her.”
16.cmn: 並要從捆裏抽出些來，留在地下任她拾取，不可叱嚇她。」
16.tao: a kakaro na rana do nivaod da sya, kato na rana ngyanan do tana a komali sya. Ji ta oyyan.”

17.niv: So Ruth gleaned in the field until evening. Then she threshed the barley she had gathered, and it amounted to about an ephah.
17.cmn: 這樣，路得在田間拾取麥穗，直到晚上，將所拾取的打了，約有一伊法大麥。
17.tao: So nikamimin na ni Lote a mangap so mogi do nihakawan da. Mangay do mahep am akmey asa ka keypong o nipeysinsinmo na no mogis.

18.niv: She carried it back to town, and her mother-in-law saw how much she had gathered. Ruth also brought out and gave her what she had left over after she had eaten enough.
18.cmn: 她就把所拾取的帶進城去給婆婆看，又把她吃飽了所剩的給了婆婆。
18.tao: O mavakes rana am yangay na o nipeysinsinmo na do ili a itoro do mavakes na. O nimavezed rana am itoro na do mavakes na.

19.niv: Her mother-in-law asked her, “Where did you glean today? Where did you work? Blessed be the man who took notice of you!”
19.cmn: 婆婆問她說：「你今日在哪裏拾取麥穗，在哪裏做工呢？願那顧恤你的得福。」路得就告訴婆婆說：「我今日在一個名叫波阿斯的人那裏做工。」
19.tao: Maniring o mavakes na ji Lote am, “Do wanjin mo mangap so mogi sicyaraw eya. Do wanjin mo meyvazay. Inaoy si ipanlanlag na ni Ama ta do to o yamarilaw nimo.” Maniring si Lote do mavakes na am, “Yako meyvazay do vahay ni Poatse a tao sicyaraw eya.”

20.niv: “The Lord bless him!” Naomi said to her daughter-in-law. “He has not stopped showing his kindness to the living and the dead.” She added, “That man is our close relative; he is one of our guardian-redeemers.”
20.cmn: 拿俄米對兒婦說：「願那人蒙耶和華賜福，因為他不斷地恩待活人死人。」拿俄米又說：「那是我們本族的人，是一個至近的親屬。」
20.tao: Maniring si Naemey do anak na mavakes am, “Inaoy no si ipanlanlag na ni Ama ta do to, do na karilaw no mavyay a kano nimawakwak a tao.” Maniring pa si Naemey jya am, “Iya rana am zipos ta, akma tey kakteh do cinai.”

21.niv: Then Ruth the Moabite said, “He even said to me, ‘Stay with my workers until they finish harvesting all my grain.’ ”
21.cmn: 摩押女子路得說：「他對我說：『你要緊隨我的僕人拾取麥穗，直等他們收完了我的莊稼。』」
21.tao: Maniring o mavakes do Moyse a meyngaran so Lote am, “Yamaniring jyaken am, ‘To ka macihza do lamlamsoy ko a meykala so mogi, mangay no si mabsoy sira do nihakawan ko.’ ”

22.niv: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, “It will be good for you, my daughter, to go with the women who work for him, because in someone elseʼs field you might be harmed.”
22.cmn: 拿俄米對兒婦路得說：「女兒啊，你跟着他的使女出去，不叫人遇見你在別人田間，這才為好。」
22.tao: Maniring si Naemey do mavakes na si Lote am, “Manganako, macihza ka do lamlamsoy na mavakes. Ji mo mancyan do tao do nihakawan da, ta apyapya pa ori.”

23.niv: So Ruth stayed close to the women of Boaz to glean until the barley and wheat harvests were finished. And she lived with her mother-in-law.
23.cmn: 於是路得與波阿斯的使女常在一處拾取麥穗，直到收完了大麥和小麥。路得仍與婆婆同住。
23.tao: So nikamimin da ni Lote a kano mavakes a lamlamsoy na ni Poatse a meykingking so mogi, mangay do nipakas da rana so mogi. So nipacivahay ni Lote do vahay no icyarwa na mavakes.

1.niv: One day Ruthʼs mother-in-law Naomi said to her, “My daughter, I must find a home for you, where you will be well provided for.
1.cmn: 路得的婆婆拿俄米對她說：「女兒啊，我不當為你找個安身之處，使你享福嗎？
1.tao: Maniring o icyarwa na mavakes ni Lote a meyngaran si Naomi am, “Manganako, jyabo kaji ko meykala nimo so vahay a isaray mo a.

2.niv: Now Boaz, with whose women you have worked, is a relative of ours. Tonight he will be winnowing barley on the threshing floor.
2.cmn: 你與波阿斯的使女常在一處，波阿斯不是我們的親族嗎？他今夜在場上簸大麥；
2.tao: Yamo masangib a yamacivahavahay do lamlamsoy ni Poatse. Manngwa, beken a zipos na yaten ni Poatse? Cyaha, ta yamyan do rarahan sicyaraw eya a yameymowa so mogi.

3.niv: Wash, put on perfume, and get dressed in your best clothes. Then go down to the threshing floor, but donʼt let him know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking.
3.cmn: 你要沐浴抹膏，換上衣服，下到場上，卻不要使那人認出你來。你等他吃喝完了，
3.tao: Meyratateng am meysorod ka kapalit mo so ayob mo a kangay mo rana do vahay da. Am ji mo mancyan do tao ang o kai da nimo. Ta no si mabsoy rana o kanen na am ori o ipakateneng da jimo.

4.niv: When he lies down, note the place where he is lying. Then go and uncover his feet and lie down. He will tell you what to do.”
4.cmn: 到他睡的時候，你看準他睡的地方，就進去掀開他腳上的被，躺臥在那裏，他必告訴你所當做的事。」
4.tao: No mitkeh rana am to mo na cita o yanan na. Si mangay ka omovay so ayob do ai na meyraraten am mangay ka mitkeh. Ta ipanci na jimo ni Yeso o vazay ko jimo.”

5.niv: “I will do whatever you say,” Ruth answered.
5.cmn: 路得說：「凡你所吩咐的，我必遵行。」
5.tao: Maniring si Lote am, “O ciring mo am amizngen ko.”

6.niv: So she went down to the threshing floor and did everything her mother-in-law told her to do.
6.cmn: 路得就下到場上，照她婆婆所吩咐她的而行。
6.tao: Ori o nipeyhekas na rana ni Lote a mangay do vahay a mahap so ciring na no icyarwa na mavakes.

7.niv: When Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he went over to lie down at the far end of the grain pile. Ruth approached quietly, uncovered his feet and lay down.
7.cmn: 波阿斯吃喝完了，心裏歡暢，就去睡在麥堆旁邊。路得便悄悄地來掀開他腳上的被，躺臥在那裏。
7.tao: Teyka na rana koman a keyyop na am masaray o onowned na a kangay na mitkeh do siri no nihakawan a kapeygonagonay na rana. Meyratateng am mangay na rana miminan no tana o tokap na ni Pite a kapeygonagonay na rana.

8.niv: In the middle of the night something startled the man; he turned—and there was a woman lying at his feet!
8.cmn: 到了夜半，那人忽然驚醒，翻過身來，不料有女子躺在他的腳下。
8.tao: Avak no ahep am to meyvangon a kapeyvwak na a tomita so asa ka mavakes a miray do tangain na.

9.cmn: 他就說：「你是誰？」回答說：「我是你的婢女路得。求你用你的衣襟遮蓋我，因為你是我一個至近的親屬。」
9.tao: Maniring am, “Sino ka.” Maniring am, “Yaken rana am si Lote ko a lamlamsoy mo. Apyapya rana o kapanta mo nyaken so ayob mo, ta imo rana am zipos namen a zipos.”

10.niv: “The Lord bless you, my daughter,” he replied. “This kindness is greater than that which you showed earlier: You have not run after the younger men, whether rich or poor.
10.cmn: 波阿斯說：「女兒啊，願你蒙耶和華賜福。你末後的恩比先前更大；因為少年人無論貧富，你都沒有跟從。
10.tao: Maniring pa si Poatse am, “Manganako, inaoy si ipanlanlag na imo ni Ama ta do to. Yaro pa o vayo a nakenakem mo a kano kakwa an. Ta tana mabsoy sira o malalavayo a tao am yabo mo nakenakem jyaken a mahap so vazay na.

11.niv: And now, my daughter, donʼt be afraid. I will do for you all you ask. All the people of my town know that you are a woman of noble character.
11.cmn: 女兒啊，現在不要懼怕，凡你所說的，我必照着行；我本城的人都知道你是個賢德的女子。
11.tao: Am ori o ji mo anyaheyan, manganako. Cyaha, ta amizngen ko o ciring mo. Ta da mamimin o tao do ili namen a yamakateneng jimo a tey mapatak a mavakes.”

12.niv: Although it is true that I am a guardian-redeemer of our family, there is another who is more closely related than I.
12.cmn: 我實在是你一個至近的親屬，只是還有一個人比我更近。
12.tao: Manoyong ko a zipos mo. Am amyan pa so asa ka tao a arakorako pa so nakenakem jyaken a zipos.

13.niv: Stay here for the night, and in the morning if he wants to do his duty as your guardian-redeemer, good; let him redeem you. But if he is not willing, as surely as the Lord lives I will do it. Lie here until morning.”
13.cmn: 你今夜在這裏住宿，明早他若肯為你盡親屬的本分，就由他吧！倘若不肯，我指着永生的耶和華起誓，我必為你盡了本分，你只管躺到天亮。」
13.tao: To ka ngyan do jya sicyaraw eya. Apyapya rana kato na ngyanan do vahay mo simaraw. Am no si ji na norwan am to ko na mancyan imo do ngaran na ni Ama ta do to a manoyong a mavyay a Tao do to, ta todey mangononong do mina ciring ko jimo. So to mo ngyani pa do ipeysinsinmo na."

14.niv: So she lay at his feet until morning, but got up before anyone could be recognized; and he said, “No one must know that a woman came to the threshing floor.”
14.cmn: 路得便在他腳下躺到天快亮，人彼此不能辨認的時候就起來了。波阿斯說：「不可使人知道有女子到場上來」；
14.tao: So nitanek na rana do tangain na ni Pite mangay do pezak rana. Meyratateng am meyvangon rana, do kaji da makatenngan jya no tao. Maniring si Poatse am, “Ji ta mancyan do tao o kanimai da no mavavakes do jya.”

15.niv: He also said, “Bring me the shawl you are wearing and hold it out.” When she did so, he poured into it six measures of barley and placed the bundle on her. Then he went back to town.
15.cmn: 又對路得說：「打開你所披的外衣。」她打開了，波阿斯就撮了六簸箕大麥，幫她扛在肩上，她便進城去了。
15.tao: Maniring pa ji Lote am, “Pakaro o magorogod mo.” Makarahan am pakaro na o magorogod na ni Poatse a kakcikcil na so alima ka yala no mogis a pazavozen do likod na a kangay na rana do ili.

16.niv: When Ruth came to her mother-in-law, Naomi asked, “How did it go, my daughter?”
16.cmn: 路得回到婆婆那裏，婆婆說：「女兒啊，怎麼樣了？」路得就將那人向她所行的述說了一遍，
16.tao: Meysinaoli si Lote do vahay no icyarwa na mavakes am maniring o mavakes am, “Kokay.” Meyratateng am ononongan na rana ni Lote o mina vazay na jya no tao do dang.

17.niv: and added, “He gave me these six measures of barley, saying, ‘Donʼt go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.’ ”
17.cmn: 又說：「那人給了我六簸箕大麥，對我說：『你不可空手回去見你的婆婆。』」
17.tao: Maniring pa am, “Na nitoro jyaken no tao ang so meykamadadayan a mogi, ta maniring jyaken am, ‘Ji ka meysinaoli a meyminaminasi no icyarwa mo a mavakes.’ ”

18.niv: Then Naomi said, “Wait, my daughter, until you find out what happens. For the man will not rest until the matter is settled today.”
18.cmn: 婆婆說：「女兒啊，你只管安坐等候，看這事怎樣成就，因為那人今日不辦成這事必不休息。」
18.tao: Maniring o mavakes na am, “Manganako, to mo na naknakma o vazay eya. Ta no si ji na ngapa o akman sang a vazay sicyaraw eya am jyabo kaji na meywalam a.”

1.niv: Meanwhile Boaz went up to the town gate and sat down there just as the guardian-redeemer he had mentioned came along. Boaz said, “Come over here, my friend, and sit down.” So he went over and sat down.
1.cmn: 波阿斯到了城門，坐在那裏，恰巧波阿斯所說的那至近的親屬經過。波阿斯說：「某人哪，你來坐在這裏。」他就來坐下。
1.tao: Makaranes si Poatse do samorangan no ili da am amlisna do dang. Meyratateng am to ngyan pa dang o mina zipos na kagagan na ni Poatse. Maniring si Poatse am, “Sijya, mo kahakay.” Am ori o nilisna na rana.

2.niv: Boaz took ten of the elders of the town and said, “Sit here,” and they did so.
2.cmn: 波阿斯又從本城的長老中揀選了十人，對他們說：「請你們坐在這裏。」他們就都坐下。
2.tao: Meyratateng am mamnek si Poatse so asa ngarnan (10) a kamanrarakehan do ili da. Maniring jira am, “Lisna kamo do jya.” Am ori o nilisna da rana.

3.niv: Then he said to the guardian-redeemer, “Naomi, who has come back from Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our relative Elimelek.
3.cmn: 波阿斯對那至近的親屬說：「從摩押地回來的拿俄米，現在要賣我們族兄以利米勒的那塊地；
3.tao: Maniring si Poatse do zipos na mahakay am, “Si Naemey rana nimapo do Moyse am na to mimina ipanazang o nihakawan no kakteh ta si Idimele.

4.niv: I thought I should bring the matter to your attention and suggest that you buy it in the presence of these seated here and in the presence of the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, do so. But if you will not, tell me, so I will know. For no one has the right to do it except you, and I am next in line.”
4.cmn: 我想當贖那塊地的是你，其次是我，以外再沒有別人了。你可以在這裏的人面前和我本國的長老面前說明，你若肯贖就贖，若不肯贖就告訴我。」那人回答說：「我肯贖。」
4.tao: Ko kakzeben imo a mahap so nihakawan ang. Ta yabo ikararwa mo a mahap sya. So pancyan mo nya do tangain no aro a tao do jya kano kamanrarakehan namen. No si apyahen mo am to mo na mancyan jyaken. No si ji mo amya am to mo na mancyan jyaken.” Maniring o tao ori am, “Noon, apyahen ko.”

5.niv: Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the land from Naomi, you also acquire Ruth the Moabite, the dead manʼs widow, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property.”
5.cmn: 波阿斯說：「你從拿俄米手中買這地的時候，也當娶死人的妻摩押女子路得，使死人在產業上存留他的名。」
5.tao: Maniring si Poatse am, “No si manazang ka so nihakawan ji Naomi am ahapen mo pa o mavakes no nimawakwak a tao a meyngaran so Lote a mavakes do Moyse. Ta ori o ngaran no nimawakwak a tao a mahap so nihakawan na.”

6.niv: At this, the guardian-redeemer said, “Then I cannot redeem it because I might endanger my own estate. You redeem it yourself. I cannot do it.”
6.cmn: 那人說：「這樣我就不能贖了，恐怕於我的產業有礙。你可以贖我所當贖的，我不能贖了。」
6.tao: Maniring o lamlamsoy na am, “No komwan am ji ko na peykabobwa, ta meydedna jyaken o kangangay ko. So to mo na peykabobwa so ngina na, ta ji ko peykabobwa.”

7.niv: (Now in earlier times in Israel, for the redemption and transfer of property to become final, one party took off his sandal and gave it to the other. This was the method of legalizing transactions in Israel.)
7.cmn: 從前，在以色列中要定奪甚麼事，或贖回，或交易，這人就脫鞋給那人。以色列人都以此為證據。
7.tao: No kakwa pa am no myan so Isedi a tao a amnakenakem so keyyan no makahakaw a tao am to na rana pakaro o tokap na katoro na nya do makahakaw a tao. So ikamimin da no Isedi a tao a makateneng do akman sang a vazay.

8.niv: So the guardian-redeemer said to Boaz, “Buy it yourself.” And he removed his sandal.
8.cmn: 那人對波阿斯說：「你自己買吧！」於是將鞋脫下來了。
8.tao: Maniring o tao ji Poatse am, “Ahap pala.” Meyratateng am opsowen na o tokap na.

9.niv: Then Boaz announced to the elders and all the people, “Today you are witnesses that I have bought from Naomi all the property of Elimelek, Kilion and Mahlon.
9.cmn: 波阿斯對長老和眾民說：「你們今日作見證，凡屬以利米勒和基連、瑪倫的，我都從拿俄米手中置買了；
9.tao: Maniring si Poatse do kamanrarakehan a kano aro a tao am, “Inyo rana am yongkad ko jinyo sicyaraw eya a yatomalamozong ni Idimele a kani Kilen a kani Malon a nipalit ko do lima ni Naemey.

10.niv: I have also acquired Ruth the Moabite, Mahlonʼs widow, as my wife, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property, so that his name will not disappear from among his family or from his hometown. Today you are witnesses!”
10.cmn: 又娶了瑪倫的妻摩押女子路得為妻，好在死人的產業上存留他的名，免得他的名在本族本鄉滅沒。你們今日可以作見證。」
10.tao: Nipapapen na o mavakes ni Malon a meyngaran so Lote a mavakes ni Moyse, ipakateneng da do ngaran no nimawakwak a tao do ili da. So ikanoyong no ngaran na mavezed do iheyhakaw na, do kaji na rana mabalinas no ngaran na ni Malon do ili da. Inyo rana am yongkad na sicyaikwaya.”

11.niv: Then the elders and all the people at the gate said, “We are witnesses. May the Lord make the woman who is coming into your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the family of Israel. May you have standing in Ephrathah and be famous in Bethlehem.
11.cmn: 在城門坐着的眾民和長老都說：「我們作見證。願耶和華使進你家的這女子，像建立以色列家的拉結、利亞二人一樣。又願你在以法他得亨通，在伯利恆得名聲。
11.tao: Maniring sira o myan do samorangan no ili a tao a kano kamanrarakehan am, “Namen meylimwang nya jinyo. Inaoy no si itoro na ni Ama ta do to do mavakes a mavakes eya o aryarilaw na jimo, akman si Reyci a kani Leya a nimapeypararako so vahay da no Isedi a tao. Inaoy no si macita da imo no tao do Ivata kapeypakdeng no ngaran mo do Podiheng.

12.niv: Through the offspring the Lord gives you by this young woman, may your family be like that of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah.”
12.cmn: 願耶和華從這少年女子賜你後裔，使你的家像她瑪從猶大所生法勒斯的家一般。」
12.tao: Inaoy no si itoro na jimo ni Ama ta do to o sivosivovoong mo a kapalit na pa no sivosivovoong mo. So icyakman mo so sivosivovoong ni Veyletse a anak na ni Tama a nimalikey ji Yoda.”

13.niv: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife. When he made love to her, the Lord enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.
13.cmn: 於是，波阿斯娶了路得為妻，與她同房。耶和華使她懷孕生了一個兒子。
13.tao: Karahan am pasakain na ni Poatse si Lote a mavakes. So nipacivahay da rana. So nipanta na sya ni Ama ta do to so kapangalavat na so anak na mahakay.

14.niv: The women said to Naomi: “Praise be to the Lord, who this day has not left you without a guardian-redeemer. May he become famous throughout Israel!
14.cmn: 婦人們對拿俄米說：「耶和華是應當稱頌的！因為今日沒有撇下你，使你無至近的親屬。願這孩子在以色列中得名聲。
14.tao: Maniring sira o mavavakes ji Naomey am, “Isaray ta si Ama ta do to. Ta yana nimahap imo sicyaraw eya. So na ikabo rana no yamacikto jimo a somidong jimo. Inaoy no si makdeng o ngaran no kanakan do Isedi.

15.niv: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and who is better to you than seven sons, has given him birth.”
15.cmn: 他必提起你的精神，奉養你的老，因為是愛慕你的那兒婦所生的。有這兒婦比有七個兒子還好！」
15.tao: So ikapyapya na pa no nakenakem mo, ta peyveyveknen na o anak mo a ikapyapya na pa kano papito a ka mahakay.”

16.niv: Then Naomi took the child in her arms and cared for him.
16.cmn: 拿俄米就把孩子抱在懷中，作他的養母。
16.tao: Karahan am ahapen na rana ni Naemey o kanakan a kapeyveyveken na sya.

17.niv: The women living there said, “Naomi has a son!” And they named him Obed. He was the father of Jesse, the father of David.
17.cmn: 鄰舍的婦人說：「拿俄米得孩子了！」就給孩子起名叫俄備得。這俄備得是耶西的父，耶西是大衛的父。
17.tao: Maniring o katakataib da mavakes am, “Yana nimalikey rana o anak ni Naemey.” Am ori o ningaran da jya si Opeyte. Si Opeyte am ama na ni Yesi. Si Yesi am ama na ni Tawey.

18.niv: This, then, is the family line of Perez:
18.cmn: 法勒斯的後代記在下面：法勒斯生希斯崙；
18.tao: O ineynapo na ni Veyletse am meyngaran so Heselon.

19.cmn: 希斯崙生蘭；蘭生亞米拿達；
19.tao: Si Heso rana am nimapodpod si Lotan. Si Lotan am nimapodpod si Aminata.

20.cmn: 亞米拿達生拿順；拿順生撒門；
20.tao: O anak na ni Aminata am si Nason. O anak na ni Nason am si Saarmen.

21.cmn: 撒門生波阿斯；波阿斯生俄備得；
21.tao: O anak na ni Saarmen am si Poatse. O anak na ni Poatse am si Opeyte.

22.cmn: 俄備得生耶西；耶西生大衛。
22.tao: O anak na ni Opeyte am si Yesi. O anak na ni Yesi am si Tawey.
